summary: Čedomil Veljačić worked in Buddhist studies, philosophy, and Indology. He studied at the University of Bonn and the University of Zagreb, where he earned a B.A. (~1934–1939), a Ph.D. (~1960–1962), and served as Lecturer then Assistant Professor of Asian Philosophy (1961).
Čeněk Vyhnis was an Indologist and linguist who studied at Charles University (1864–1867) under Alfred Ludwig. In 1891, he held a post at Charles University as a gymnasium professor of classics.
